attrs.evidence: trvm_world.mjs L-WAR-1: component-size warrant fresh at seal and STILL fresh after 50 unrelated writes; goes stale precisely when its footprint moves (L-WAR-4).
attrs.statement: A warrant is a VERIFYING TRACE generalized: freshness(warrant, world) iff every exact read [resource@version] and every predicate scope [query@digest] re-evaluates unchanged. Unrelated writes never invalidate — freshness reads the footprint, not the world's write counter. (The build-systems verifying-trace idea, plus the predicate-lock idea from serializable databases, as one shape.)
